scope: Legally mutated custom opponents with no consistent team in shipped belief prior. Nested search checkpoints. Choice stability alone does not establish strength saturation.
followup: Evaluate different selected actions under identical post-preview RNG, opponent selection, and battle budgets; treat matching choices as exactly equal. Report relative saturation to tested reference, never a global guarantee.

continuation.unit: 16 independent custom opponents; both search seeds and all continuation trials clustered by opponent
continuation.criterion: Smallest candidate whose 98.333 percentile bootstrap upper bound on reference gain is <= 0.03 (Bonferroni one-sided 5% for three candidates). Fixed 100000 resamples, seed 20261017012. Relative saturation only to this reference and custom-team generator.
continuation.stopping: Fixed complete grid; matching selections have exactly zero score contrast without simulation.
